Press & Media

Facts, figures, and how to cite us.

What WorthIt Goods is

An independent deal and price-research site tracking real retailer prices for software, VPNs, utilities, and everyday gear, with daily-refreshed comparisons and an email newsletter. Launched 2026. Independently operated; not owned or funded by any brand we cover.

By the numbers

  • 246 products tracked with live retailer pricing, refreshed daily
  • ~13,529 readers/month (as of November 2026), primarily organic search
  • Every published price links back to its named retailer source — nothing is estimated or invented

Citation & reuse

Cite any page freely with attribution and a link-back ("Source: WorthIt Goods"). For dataset excerpts, syndication, or quote requests, email us.

Media contact

support@worthitgoods.com — press queries answered within two business days.
